::: {#sol-root-first}

$m, f, c, h, j, t, r, p, w$.
The root $m$ comes first.
Next comes the left subtree, rooted at $f$: first $f$, then its left subtree, $c$, then its right subtree, $h$ followed by $j$.
Last comes the right subtree, rooted at $t$: first $t$, then $r$ followed by $p$, then $w$.

:::
